units.source_text: 用孩子般天真的嗓子任情不拘地吟出，亦自娇媚可爱。

en.t: She sang it out freely and without restraint in a childlike, innocent voice, which made her all the more charming and lovely.

units.source_text: 源氏便坐下来，叹息一声，说道：“呀，行不得也！”

en.t: Genji sat down, gave a sigh, and said, "Ah, I cannot go after all!"
